name: Rectifier diode (1N4007)
description: A rugged rectifier diode (black body, grey band = cathode K). Current flows only from the anode (A) to the cathode; it drops about 0.7 V and blocks up to 1000 V the other way. Use it to protect against reversed batteries, to rectify, and as the flyback diode across motors and relay coils (band towards +). Up to 1 A.
